mapper.sql: id, task_key, module_name, node_id, is_locked, lock_time, heartbeat_time, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE distributed_task_locks SET is_locked = TRUE, node_id = #{nodeId}, lock_time = NOW(), heartbeat_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE task_key = #{taskKey} AND is_locked = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO distributed_task_locks (task_key, module_name, node_id, is_locked, version) VALUES (#{taskKey}, #{moduleName}, '', FALSE, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE distributed_task_locks SET is_locked = FALSE, lock_time = NULL, heartbeat_time = NULL, node_id = '', version = version + 1 WHERE is_locked = 1 AND heartbeat_time < #{expireTime}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM distributed_task_locks ORDER BY module_name, task_key
